newsitem.title: USA: Salomon raises U.S. Filter 1998 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: Salomon raises U.S. Filter 1998 EPS view.

text.p: Salomon Brothers analyst Michael Sargent said he raised his 1998 earnings per share forecast for U.S. Filter Corp to $1.15 from $1.05.

In a research note, Sargent cited U.S. Filter's purchase of a substantial portion of Wheelabrator Technologies Inc water business. He said the transaction not only gives U.S. Filter access to the municipal wastewater market but also enhances the value of its recently acquired distribution assets.
Shares were unchanged at 30-1/2 on Tuesday morning.
